subject: Post-call: PayPrism savings playbook and pilot sizing
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Gomez <alex.gomez@payprism.ai>
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com, connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: PayPrism savings playbook and pilot sizing

Alex — great to speak earlier. Thanks for walking through PayPrism's current flow and the quote/approval constraints. Below is a concise recap, recommended levers we can test in a short pilot, and proposed next steps so procurement can evaluate the ROI quickly.

Recap (pain & goals)
- Pain: 3x bursty payment matching jobs at peak with per-request latency spikes and token costs driven by long metadata prefixes.
- Goal: Reduce inference spend to fit Q4 budget while preserving sub-200ms P95 for critical user flows; be pilot-ready for a production rollout in H1.

Key numbers you shared (for reference)
- Avg prompt size (including metadata): ~1,200 tokens
- Peak daily requests (parsing/matching): ~350k/day in peak windows
- Current internal estimate: ~60M tokens/month in production (conservative)

Cost/TCO levers we recommend testing in pilot
1) Prefix & KV caching: cache common merchant & customer metadata chunks (expected effective prompt reduction 20–45% depending on hit rate). See attached prefix analysis.
2) Intelligent batching: short (50–150ms) batching windows for non-interactive jobs — estimated 25–40% token-cost drop due to throughput efficiency and reduced per-request overhead.
3) Model quantization / cheaper variants: run reranking on a smaller quantized model for high-volume non-critical paths; use higher-capacity model only for final pass. Potential 30–50% compute cost reduction on those paths.
4) Dedicated vs hosted routing: short-term hosted pilot gives quickest time-to-insight; we can model Dedicated if your committed throughput makes it economical.

Pilot proposal (3-week window) — quick summary
- Scope: prefix caching + batching + one quantized rerank path on historical traffic slice (approx. 3–5M tokens/week).
- Objective: validate per-token reduction, latency impact, and implementation effort estimate for engineering.
- Success criteria: >=30% reduction in effective tokens (or cost) for batched/cached paths while keeping user-facing latency impact <= +30ms P95 on interactive endpoints.

Estimated cost math (hosted pilot) — rough back-of-envelope
- Baseline hosted cost assumption: $0.0008 per input token equivalent (example internal list price; final pricing in pilot estimate).
- Pilot volume: ~15M tokens over 3 weeks -> baseline cost ~ $12k
- If we hit 30% effective token reduction -> pilot cost reduction line item ~ $3.6k (savings signal for ROI).

Attachments
- payprism_prefix_analysis.csv (simple frequency table of repeatable metadata blocks)
- redwood_pilot_estimate_Q4.pdf (three pricing scenarios: hosted quick test / dedicated small pool / hybrid)

Next steps (concrete)
1) I’ll drop the two attachments and a short pilot estimate to your Drive link after this message.
2) You confirm procurement contact and any legal procurement windows (Alex -> procurement@payprism.ai).
3) If approved, we schedule a 30-min kickoff with engineering + data samples by next Tue (Dec 15).

Thanks — looping in Hannah & Connor for sizing & pricing alignment.

—
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0132

Attachments: payprism_prefix_analysis.csv, redwood_pilot_estimate_Q4.pdf

Thanks, Soojin — this is really helpful and close to what we need to show finance. A couple quick asks: 

- Can you provide a one-page ROI snapshot that shows (a) delta vs our current baseline spend at 30% reduction and (b) a tail-case where we only get 15%? Finance will need both.
- Procurement asked whether the pilot is covered under a short SOW or can proceed under an evaluation agreement — I copied them.
- Do you have an estimated timeline if we go hosted-only vs dedicated (time to data)?

Also copying our engineering lead (will loop separately if needed) — we can provide a 7-day traffic dump for the pilot.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Alex / team — looping in expected internal pricing and pilot sizing. Quick notes from an ops/pricing perspective so procurement has concrete numbers to evaluate: 

Pilot options (short):
- Hosted quick test (fastest)
  * Pilot duration: 3 weeks; test slice: historical 7-day traffic (anonymized).
  * Estimate: 15M tokens -> hosted list cost ~ $12k. With expected lever gains (batching + caching) net expected spend ~ $8–9k.
- Dedicated small pool (if you expect sustained high concurrency)
  * Capacity: 2x A100-equivalent dedicated nodes for staging -> setup lead ~3–4 weeks + procurement lead time.
  * Economics: amortized committed monthly cost becomes attractive at >200M tokens/month.

Implementation asks:
- Engineering: we need three things from PayPrism: traffic dump (7 days), a representative end-to-end request/response trace, and a canonical list of repeatable metadata tokens.
- Legal/procurement: evaluation agreement template or SOW to cover data handling; our legal team can fast-track a 30-day evaluation agreement.

Connor and I will prepare the one-pager ROI snapshot — Soojin, can you confirm whether Alex prefers absolute dollar ARR impact or percentage savings for finance? We can provide both, but want the preferred format.

Hannah Schmitt
Principal, Solutions Ops | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com
